name: Amagamine Renna
source:
She is the number two girl in the idol unit "Gloria * Snow", which has recently started to gain popularity, and is a hardworking girl. 

In an unexpected turn of events, she starts to have an interest in the protagonist, but her guess is not her own, but that of her rival Yuna, and maybe because of the rivalry, she starts to get involved in the protagonist's life, but she has yet to move beyond her junior member. 

She tries to use her acting skills to get the upper hand in a mischievous manner, but she struggles with her inability to do so thoroughly. Shion, a former great national actress, is her mother, and although she tries not to call her "mama" in public, she can't help but do that out of habit.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.asa-pro.com/koirowa/character/chara4.html]official website[/url]]
